intro: '오픽 만능패턴 72문장' 영상의 구성대로 정리했습니다. 답변에 반복해서 나오는 이야기를 12개 테마로 묶고, 테마마다 6개 패턴, 패턴마다 예문 3개(총 216문장)입니다. 답변을 외우지 말고 패턴의 빈칸(___)에 주제만 바꿔 끼우는 연습을 하세요.

source.title: 오픽만능패턴 72문장 · 강지완 오픽TV
source.note: 12개 답변 스토리 테마 × 6패턴 = 72패턴 · 패턴당 예문 3개 = 216문장. 학습법: 패턴을 한 번 익히고 → 예문을 따라 말하고 → 빈칸에 내 주제를 넣어 말하기.

groups.title: 1. 좋아하는 것 (What)
groups.desc: 무엇을 즐기는지 첫 문장으로 던지기. 주제 단어만 바꾸면 어떤 설문 주제든 시작됩니다.

items.en: I really enjoy listening to music in my free time.
items.pattern: I really enjoy ___ in my free time.
examples: I really enjoy watching movies in my free time.
I really enjoy traveling in my free time.

items.en: One of my favorite things to do is going jogging.
items.ko: 제가 가장 좋아하는 일 중 하나는 ___예요.
items.pattern: One of my favorite things to do is ___.
examples: One of my favorite things to do is going to the park.
One of my favorite things to do is trying new cafes.

items.en: I'm really into K-pop these days.
examples: I'm really into hiking these days.
I'm really into cooking these days.

items.en: Music is a big part of my life.
items.pattern: ___ is a big part of my life.
examples: Exercise is a big part of my life.
Traveling is a big part of my life.

items.en: I'm the kind of person who loves spending time outdoors.
items.pattern: I'm the kind of person who loves ___.
examples: I'm the kind of person who loves staying at home.
I'm the kind of person who loves meeting new people.

items.en: When it comes to movies, I'm a huge fan of action films.
items.pattern: When it comes to ___, I'm a huge fan of ___.
examples: When it comes to music, I'm a huge fan of ballads.
When it comes to food, I'm a huge fan of Korean dishes.

groups.title: 2. 장소 (Where)
groups.desc: 어디서 하는지. '위치 → 가는 방법 → 그곳이 좋은 점' 순서로 이어 붙이세요.

items.en: I usually go jogging at the park near my house.
examples: I usually watch movies at home.
I usually study at a cafe downtown.

items.en: There's a big park near my place.
examples: There's a nice cafe near my place.
There's a movie theater near my place.

items.en: It's only a five-minute walk from my house.
items.pattern: It's only a ___-minute walk from my house.
examples: It's only a ten-minute walk from my house.
It's only a fifteen-minute bus ride from my house.

items.en: My favorite place to relax is my living room.
examples: My favorite place to go for a walk is the river park.
My favorite place to travel is Jeju Island.

items.en: It's located right next to the subway station, so it's easy to get to.
items.pattern: It's located ___, so it's easy to get to.
examples: It's located in the middle of the city, so it's easy to get to.
It's located near my office, so it's easy to get to.

items.en: What I like most about the place is that it's always quiet.
items.pattern: What I like most about the place is that ___.
examples: What I like most about the place is that it has a great view.
What I like most about the place is that it's never too crowded.

groups.title: 3. 함께하는 사람 (Who)
groups.desc: 누구와 하는지. 사람을 등장시키면 이야기가 길어지고 생생해집니다.

items.en: I usually go to the movies with my friends.
examples: I usually go jogging with my brother.
I usually travel with my family.

items.en: Sometimes I go to the park alone because I need some time to think.
examples: Sometimes I watch movies alone because I can focus better.
Sometimes I travel alone because it's more relaxing.

items.en: My best friend and I have a lot in common.
items.pattern: My ___ and I have a lot in common.
examples: My sister and I have a lot in common.
My coworker and I have a lot in common.

items.en: I have a friend named Minsu, and we go hiking together.
items.pattern: I have a friend named ___, and we ___ together.
examples: I have a friend named Jiyoung, and we go to concerts together.
I have a friend named Junho, and we play basketball together.

items.en: It's more fun to watch movies with someone than by myself.
items.pattern: It's more fun to ___ with someone than by myself.
examples: It's more fun to exercise with someone than by myself.
It's more fun to travel with someone than by myself.

items.en: Spending time with my family helps me relieve stress.
examples: Spending time with my friends helps me forget about work.
Spending time with my dog helps me feel calm.

groups.title: 4. 빈도·루틴 (How often · How)
groups.desc: 얼마나 자주, 어떤 순서로 하는지. 빈도부사 + First / Then / After that.

items.en: I go jogging about three times a week.
examples: I go to the movies about twice a month.
I go to a cafe about four times a week.

items.en: I try to listen to music whenever I have free time.
items.pattern: I try to ___ whenever I have free time.
examples: I try to go for a walk whenever I have free time.
I try to read books whenever I have free time.

items.en: Before I go jogging, I always stretch for a few minutes.
examples: Before I watch a movie, I always check the reviews.
Before I travel, I always make a plan.

items.en: First, I put on my running shoes. Then, I head to the park.
examples: First, I pick a movie. Then, I buy some snacks.
First, I make a playlist. Then, I put on my earphones.

items.en: After that, I usually take a hot shower to finish my day.
items.pattern: After that, I usually ___ to finish my day.
examples: After that, I usually read a book to finish my day.
After that, I usually call my parents to finish my day.

items.en: It has become part of my daily routine to listen to music on the subway.
items.pattern: It has become part of my daily routine to ___.
examples: It has become part of my daily routine to take a walk after dinner.
It has become part of my daily routine to drink coffee in the morning.

groups.title: 5. 좋아하는 이유 (Why)
groups.desc: 왜 좋은지 이유 2개. because / The main reason is / Plus 로 길이를 확보하세요.

items.en: I like jogging because it keeps me healthy.
examples: I like movies because they help me relax.
I like traveling because I can see new places.

items.en: The main reason is that it helps me relieve stress.
examples: The main reason is that it's cheap and easy.
The main reason is that I can spend time with my family.

items.en: It helps me clear my mind.
examples: It helps me sleep better.
It helps me stay in shape.

items.en: Another reason is that I can meet new people.
examples: Another reason is that it doesn't cost much.
Another reason is that I can do it anytime.

items.en: Whenever I listen to music, I feel refreshed.
examples: Whenever I go to the park, I feel peaceful.
Whenever I travel, I feel free.

items.en: Honestly, there's nothing better than a cold drink after a long run.
examples: Honestly, there's nothing better than watching a movie on a rainy day.
Honestly, there's nothing better than a quiet walk in the park.

groups.title: 6. 계기·시작 (How it started)
groups.desc: 처음 시작하게 된 계기. 과거시제로 말하는 첫 연습 구간입니다.

items.en: I first got into music when I was in middle school.
items.pattern: I first got into ___ when I was ___.
examples: I first got into jogging when I was in college.
I first got into cooking when I was living alone.

items.en: I started jogging about three years ago.
examples: I started learning the guitar about two years ago.
I started going to cafes about five years ago.

items.en: It all started when my friend took me to a concert.
examples: It all started when I moved to this neighborhood.
It all started when I watched a travel show on TV.

items.en: At first, I didn't like running, but now I love it.
items.pattern: At first, I ___, but now I ___.
examples: At first, I only watched comedies, but now I enjoy all kinds of movies.
At first, I was nervous about traveling alone, but now I enjoy it.

items.en: My older brother got me interested in rock music.
examples: A friend of mine got me interested in hiking.
A YouTube video got me interested in camping.

items.en: Ever since then, I've been jogging almost every day.
examples: Ever since then, I've been a big fan of that singer.
Ever since then, I've been traveling at least once a year.

groups.title: 7. 묘사 (Describe)
groups.desc: 장소·사물·사람 묘사. '전체 인상 → 세부 2~3개 → 내 느낌' 순서.

items.en: It's a quiet place with lots of trees.
examples: It's a cozy place with soft music.
It's a busy place with many shops.

items.en: When you walk in, the first thing you notice is the big window.
items.pattern: When you walk in, the first thing you notice is ___.
examples: When you walk in, the first thing you notice is the smell of coffee.
When you walk in, the first thing you notice is the huge fountain.

items.en: There's a sofa on the left and a TV on the right.
items.pattern: There's a ___ on the left and a ___ on the right.
examples: There's a bench on the left and a small pond on the right.
There's a counter on the left and some tables on the right.

items.en: It's not very big, but it's clean and comfortable.
examples: It's not very fancy, but it's really cozy.
It's not very famous, but it's beautiful.

items.en: It's famous for its cherry blossoms.
examples: It's famous for its delicious desserts.
It's famous for its beautiful night view.

items.en: It has a calm atmosphere that makes me feel relaxed.
items.pattern: It has a ___ atmosphere that makes me feel ___.
examples: It has a lively atmosphere that makes me feel energetic.
It has a warm atmosphere that makes me feel at home.

groups.title: 8. 기억에 남는 경험 (Experience)
groups.desc: 가장 기억에 남는 일. 언제 → 무슨 일 → 결과 → 느낀 점, 과거시제를 유지하세요.

items.en: I remember one time when I went to a music festival.
examples: I remember one time when I got lost in Tokyo.
I remember one time when I ran my first 10K.

items.en: It was last summer when I went to Busan with my friends.
examples: It was about two years ago when I visited Jeju Island.
It was my birthday when I saw my favorite singer live.

items.en: The most memorable trip was my first trip abroad.
examples: The most memorable concert was a BTS concert.
The most memorable movie was one I watched with my father.

items.en: To my surprise, the singer came down from the stage.
examples: To my surprise, the restaurant was completely empty.
To my surprise, I finished the race in under an hour.

items.en: It turned out to be the best day of my vacation.
examples: It turned out to be a great experience.
It turned out to be much easier than I expected.

items.en: I'll never forget that day because it was my first time traveling alone.
examples: I'll never forget that concert because the crowd was amazing.
I'll never forget that trip because I made a lifelong friend.

groups.title: 9. 문제·해결 경험 (Trouble)
groups.desc: 곤란했던 경험과 해결. 돌발·롤플레이 11~13번에도 그대로 씁니다.

items.en: Something unexpected happened when I was on my way to the airport.
examples: Something unexpected happened when I was jogging in the park.
Something unexpected happened when I was at the movie theater.

items.en: I had a problem with my flight.
examples: I had a problem with my phone.
I had a problem with my hotel reservation.

items.en: I didn't know what to do, so I called my friend.
items.pattern: I didn't know what to do, so I ___.
examples: I didn't know what to do, so I asked a staff member for help.
I didn't know what to do, so I just waited.

items.en: Luckily, a kind stranger helped me.
examples: Luckily, there was another bus ten minutes later.
Luckily, they gave me a full refund.

items.en: I ended up taking a taxi.
examples: I ended up missing the beginning of the movie.
I ended up staying one more night.

items.en: Since then, I always make sure to check my flight time twice.
items.pattern: Since then, I always make sure to ___.
examples: Since then, I always make sure to charge my phone before I leave.
Since then, I always make sure to book in advance.

groups.title: 10. 과거와 현재 (Change)
groups.desc: 변화·비교. used to / compared to / nowadays — IH 이상 필수 구간입니다.

items.en: I used to listen to CDs, but now I use streaming apps.
items.pattern: I used to ___, but now I ___.
examples: I used to watch movies at the theater, but now I watch them at home.
I used to hate exercising, but now I jog every morning.

items.en: Compared to ten years ago, my neighborhood is much busier.
examples: Compared to the past, traveling is much easier.
Compared to my old house, my new place is much bigger.

items.en: These days, people tend to watch movies on their phones.
examples: These days, people tend to travel more often.
These days, people tend to work out at home.

items.en: The biggest difference is that everything is online now.
examples: The biggest difference is that there are more cafes now.
The biggest difference is that people are more health-conscious.

items.en: My neighborhood has changed a lot over the years.
items.pattern: ___ has changed a lot over the years.
examples: The music industry has changed a lot over the years.
The way people travel has changed a lot over the years.

items.en: I think this change is because of smartphones.
items.pattern: I think this change is because of ___.
examples: I think this change is because of social media.
I think this change is because of the pandemic.

groups.title: 11. 의견·사회 이슈 (Opinion)
groups.desc: 고난도 15번 대비. 입장 → 이유 2개 → 예시 → 결론.

items.en: In my opinion, technology has made our lives easier.
examples: In my opinion, exercise is the best way to stay healthy.
In my opinion, traveling is the best way to learn.

items.en: I believe that smartphones are useful for two reasons.
items.pattern: I believe that ___ for two reasons.
examples: I believe that online shopping is convenient for two reasons.
I believe that public transportation is better for two reasons.

items.en: For example, I can pay for everything with my phone.
examples: For example, my parents now order groceries online.
For example, I can work from anywhere.

items.en: On the other hand, some people spend too much time on their phones.
examples: On the other hand, it can be bad for small businesses.
On the other hand, it's harder to meet people in person.

items.en: Many people are concerned about personal information leaks.
examples: Many people are concerned about environmental problems.
Many people are concerned about rising housing prices.

items.en: All things considered, I think the advantages outweigh the disadvantages.
examples: All things considered, I think we should use technology wisely.
All things considered, I think this trend will continue.

groups.title: 12. 롤플레이 (Role-play)
groups.desc: 질문하기 · 문제 해결 · 대안 제시. 전화 상황 시작 문장까지 통째로.

items.en: Hi, I'm calling to ask about the concert tickets.
items.pattern: Hi, I'm calling to ask about ___.
examples: Hi, I'm calling to ask about your membership.
Hi, I'm calling to ask about the apartment for rent.

items.en: I'd like to know what time you open.
examples: I'd like to know how much it costs.
I'd like to know if there's parking available.

items.en: Is it possible to change my reservation?
examples: Is it possible to get a refund?
Is it possible to bring my dog?

items.en: I'm afraid there's a problem with the tickets I bought.
items.pattern: I'm afraid there's a problem with ___.
examples: I'm afraid there's a problem with my order.
I'm afraid there's a problem with our plans for tomorrow.

items.en: How about meeting next Saturday instead?
examples: How about watching a different movie instead?
How about going to the park instead?

items.en: I'd really appreciate it if you could call me back.
items.pattern: I'd really appreciate it if you could ___.
examples: I'd really appreciate it if you could let me know by tomorrow.
I'd really appreciate it if you could help me with this.

groups.title: IM3 · 습관 · 루틴
groups.desc: 평소에 하는 일. 빈도부사(usually·often·sometimes·always)와 이동(go·take·visit)으로 루틴 답변을 만듭니다.

items.en: After work, I usually go to the gym.
examples: On weekends, I usually go to the park.
I usually go there on Fridays.
I usually go to the bank in the morning.

items.en: I often go to the park.
examples: I often eat out with my friends.
I often take the subway.
I often visit my grandparents on holidays.

items.en: I sometimes go camping with my family.
examples: I sometimes take a walk in the park.
I sometimes go to concerts on weekends.
I sometimes ride the bus when it rains.

items.en: I always visit the park on Sundays.
examples: I always eat at the same restaurant.
I always take the subway to work.
I always check the weather before I go out.

items.en: I take the bus to work.
examples: I take the subway to school.
I take a taxi when it rains.
I take the train to the city.

items.en: I visit my grandparents on weekends.
examples: I visit the museum when I travel.
I visit the hospital sometimes.
I visit new cities during holidays.

items.en: And then, I usually walk around.
examples: And then, I met my friend.
And then, I stretch my legs.
And then, I always go back home.

groups.title: IM3 · 소개 · 묘사
groups.desc: 있는 것·좋아하는 것·걸리는 시간·느낌. 묘사와 자기소개의 기본 문장입니다.

items.en: I'm really into ballads these days.
examples: I'm really into jogging.
I'm really into listening to music.
I'm really into camping.

items.en: There's a nice cafe near my place.
examples: There's a nice restaurant near my place.
There's a gym near my place.
There's a great view in the park.

items.en: I have a big TV in my living room.
examples: I have a dog at home.
I have a routine.
I have a membership at the gym.

items.en: It's sunny today.
examples: It's cold in the morning.
It's rainy this week.
It's windy outside.

items.en: It takes 10 minutes to walk to the park.
examples: It takes 30 minutes to get to the theater.
It takes an hour to go camping.
It takes 20 minutes to clean the house.

items.en: I prefer buses to subways.
examples: I prefer eating outside.
I prefer going to movies to concerts.
I prefer staying home on holidays.

items.en: I get tired after walking in the park.
examples: I get sick in cold weather.
I get hungry after the gym.
I get nervous before going on stage.

groups.title: IM3 · 과거 경험
groups.desc: 경험 문제의 필수 과거시제. went · was · had to · stayed · didn't · enjoyed 로 끝까지 과거로 말합니다.

items.en: I went to a concert last Saturday.
examples: I went to the doctor yesterday.
I went to a movie theater with friends.
I went there last year.

items.en: It was fun to go camping.
examples: It was crowded at the concert.
It was sunny and warm at the beach.
It was delicious.

items.en: I had to wait for the bus.
examples: I had to clean my room.
I had to cancel my plan.
I had to go to the hospital.

items.en: I stayed at a hotel near the beach.
examples: I stayed at my friend's house last weekend.
I stayed home all day.
I stayed at the library to study.

items.en: I was tired after the concert.
examples: I was excited about the holiday.
I was happy to eat at my favorite restaurant.
I was cold at the park last night.

items.en: I didn't go to the concert.
examples: I didn't take the bus today.
I didn't eat out last weekend.
I didn't recycle yesterday.

items.en: I enjoyed the camping trip.
examples: I enjoyed walking in the park.
I enjoyed the food at the restaurant.
I enjoyed listening to live music.

groups.title: IM3 · 계획 · 바람 · 요청
groups.desc: 앞으로 할 일과 바람, 롤플레이 요청 문장. want to · planning to · need to · I'd like to.

items.en: I want to go there again.
examples: I want to watch that movie again.
I want to go hiking next weekend.
I want to see it again.

items.en: I'm planning to go camping.
examples: I'm planning to watch a musical.
I'm planning to meet my friends.
I'm planning to join a fitness class.

items.en: I need to clean the kitchen.
examples: I need to go to the bank.
I need to take the bus.
I need to recycle some bottles.

items.en: I'd like to book a room.
examples: I'd like to get a refund.
I'd like to book the package trip.
I'd like to try it.

groups.title: Part 2 · 감정 · 솔직한 의견
groups.desc: 느낌과 호불호를 솔직하게. 묘사·의견 답변에 감정을 한 줄 더하면 IM3 이상으로 들립니다.

items.en: I get excited when I watch concerts.
examples: I get tired when I work for a long time.
I get nervous when I speak English.
I get happy when I spend time with friends.

items.en: To be honest, I don't like crowded places.
examples: To be honest, I'm not good at cooking.
To be honest, I prefer staying home.
To be honest, I was surprised.

items.en: I can't stand waiting in traffic.
examples: I can't stand noisy places.
I can't stand eating spicy food.
I can't stand being late.

items.en: I don't mind waiting.
examples: I don't mind doing chores.
I don't mind working late.
I don't mind trying new food.

items.en: I'm used to getting up early.
examples: I'm used to cold weather.
I'm used to studying alone.
I'm used to crowded places.

items.en: It seemed interesting.
examples: It seemed amazing.
It seemed nice.
It seemed expensive.

groups.title: Part 2 · 노력 · 빈도 · 상황
groups.desc: 평소에 애쓰는 일, 대부분 하는 일, 상황에 따라 다른 일. 루틴 답변을 풍성하게 만듭니다.

items.en: I try to exercise every day.
examples: I try to eat healthy food.
I try to sleep early on weekdays.
I try to avoid crowded places.

items.en: I make time for exercise every day.
examples: I make time for a walk.
I make time for reading at night.
I make time for myself.

items.en: Most of the time, I stay home.
examples: Most of the time, I take the subway.
Most of the time, I go there to jog.
Most of the time, I listen to jazz.

items.en: It depends on the weather.
examples: It depends on my mood.
It depends on the place.
It depends on the time.

items.en: It takes 30 minutes.
examples: It takes an hour.
It takes about 10 minutes.
It takes a while.

items.en: Whenever I go there, I get excited.
examples: Whenever I jog, I get excited.
Whenever I listen to that song, I get relaxed.
Whenever I watch it, I get happy.

groups.title: Part 2 · 경험 이야기 전개
groups.desc: 갑자기 → 그 후 → ~하자마자 → 돌아다니며. 경험 답변을 시간 순서로 끌고 가는 연결 패턴입니다.

items.en: Out of nowhere, it started raining.
examples: Out of nowhere, I got a call from an old friend.
Out of nowhere, the concert got canceled.
Out of nowhere, I felt really happy.

items.en: After that, I usually go back home.
examples: After that, I ate something.
After that, we took a picture.
After that, I felt better.

items.en: As soon as I got there, I took a picture.
examples: As soon as I went jogging, I felt better.
As soon as I got bored, I went for a walk.
As soon as I get up, I drink a glass of water.

items.en: I walked around and drank coffee.
examples: I walked around and talked with my friend.
I walked around and took a picture.
I walked around and looked at the shops.

items.en: There were some people.
examples: There were some places to rest.
There are so many people.
There are many types of restaurants.

items.en: It was really great.
examples: It was really satisfying.
It was really exciting.
It was one of the best concerts.

items.en: I liked the view.
examples: I liked the song.
I liked the atmosphere.
I liked the food.

groups.title: Part 2 · 좋아하는 것 · 이유
groups.desc: 제일 좋아하는 것과 가장 큰 이유, 그래서 ~해요. 묘사·의견 답변의 핵심 뼈대입니다.

items.en: One of my favorite bands is BTS.
examples: One of my favorite movie genres is action.
One of my favorite foods is Korean food.
One of my favorite places is Haeundae.

items.en: The biggest reason is that it's exciting.
examples: The biggest reason is that I was tired.
The biggest reason is that I want to lose weight.
The biggest reason is that it's energetic.

items.en: That's why I like it.
examples: That's why I like to go there.
That's why I can't forget about it.
That's why I think so.

items.en: It helps me relax.
